headline: Rajani Associates acts on Scoobee Day Garments rights issue
sum: Scoobee Day Garments (India) Limited has made a rights issue aggregating to ₹40.5 crore. Rajani Associates advised Scoobee Day Garments on this rights issue.
detail: Scoobee Day Garments (India) Limited has made a rights issue aggregating to ₹40.5 crore. Rajani Associates advised Scoobee Day Garments on this rights issue. The Firm's role included conducting legal diligence, preparing and finalizing offer related documents, preparing and finalizing the Rights Issue Agreements assisting the Company in the Rights Issue process. The transaction team consisted of Sangeeta Lakhi (Senior Partner) and Shriya Nandedkar (Associate).
